phase_rule: All zero-based phases 0 through key length minus one; reset at the red start is therefore already represented. Only runes advance the key; no internal full stop exists in the red span.
score: Mean base-10 log probability of canonical GP transliteration quadgrams; unseen floor count 0.01; pinned model, source threshold -5.5.
control_gate: At least 8 of 9 archived 51-rune reading prefixes must exceed -5.5 and outrank at least 99% of their own 200 shuffled controls; at least 8 of 9 planted two-key encipherments must rank their true plaintext first among the same 42 candidate streams. Gate before manuscript scores.
manuscript_null: If gate passes: 999 seeded shuffles of the 51 red rune indices, apply the same 42 candidate settings, compare the best score per shuffle. This is a family-wise positional null, not a cipher model or general p-value.
